Features are drawn i.i.d. from a standard normal; the label depends on the *sign agreement* of two active coordinates, so no linear function of the inputs separates the classes at all — a model must compose the two coordinates multiplicatively. ### Data-generating and classification rule
- Rule family: `xor`; active coordinates: `x_3`, `x_4`
- Feature distribution: every coordinate is sampled independently from `Normal(0, 1)`.
- Latent score:

- Label rule: `y = 1` exactly when `s(x) > 0`; otherwise `y = 0`.
- XOR interpretation: `x` is class 1 exactly when its two active coordinates have opposite signs, and class 0 when they share a sign.
